title: Sunday · Cedar · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The Sunday after the Cedar run ends: the mill, plain, no magic, the stack cold, and one cedar seedling in the yard's gravel drawn with the care the twelve Sundays gave their wonders. The run's aftertaste, in a seedling.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the mill yard, plain, gravel, the stack cold, September light.

panels.composition: Tier 2: a cedar seedling in the gravel, a hand's height, drawn with great care.

panels.name: Seedling
